title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: built-in filter for temporary file noise on endpoints
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing exclusion controls are supported, and targeted searches confirm the gaps about the planned filter. Minor corrections should complete the exclusion routes and align the impact rating with its stated effect on analysts.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-10-12T23:01:05.
Microsoft plans built-in filtering for well-known temporary file name patterns in Endpoint file operations.
claims.quote: This feature introduces built-in filtering for well-known temporary file name patterns so that Endpoint file operations are excluded from IRM activity explorer and scoring

claims.claim: Opening files in Windows can cause the operating system, Office and browsers to create temporary files.
claims.quote: When files are opened in Windows, the operating system, and applications (for example, Microsoft Office and browsers) can create, rename, and delete temporary files as part of normal behavior.

claims.claim: Opening files in Windows can cause the operating system and applications to rename temporary files.
claims.quote: When files are opened in Windows, the operating system, and applications (for example, Microsoft Office and browsers) can create, rename, and delete temporary files as part of normal behavior.

claims.claim: Opening files in Windows can cause the operating system and applications to delete temporary files.
claims.quote: When files are opened in Windows, the operating system, and applications (for example, Microsoft Office and browsers) can create, rename, and delete temporary files as part of normal behavior.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; controls[0].scope; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Global exclusions are an existing tenant-wide option for excluding file types, keywords and file paths from policy scoring, not a switch for the new filter.
claims.quote: Use the Global exclusions setting in Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management to exclude items from being scored by Insider Risk Management policies.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Purview portal route is Settings > Insider Risk Management > Insider risk settings > Global exclusions.
claims.quote: Select Settings in the upper-right corner of the page, then select Insider Risk Management to go to the Insider Risk Management settings. Under Insider risk settings, select Global exclusions.
claims.fix: Retain the correct route and complete its note and rendered table with these suffixes after Global exclusions: 'Type > File paths > Individual file paths > Add file paths to exclude'; 'Type > File types > Individual file types > Add file type'; 'Type > Keywords > Individual keywords > Exclude these keywords'. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-settings-global-exclusions.

claims.claim: Individual file path entries use File paths > Individual file paths > Add file paths to exclude.
claims.quote: In the Type panel to the right, select File paths. ... Individual file paths. To add an individual file path, select Add file paths to exclude

claims.claim: Individual file type entries use File types > Individual file types > Add file type.
claims.quote: Individual file types. To add file types one at a time, select Add file type, enter a file type, and then press Enter.

claims.claim: Individual keyword entries use Keywords > Individual keywords.
claims.quote: Individual keywords. To add keywords one at a time, enter a keyword in the Exclude these keywords field, then press Enter.
claims.fix: Replace 'Keywords > Individual keywords' with 'Keywords > Individual keywords > Exclude these keywords' in controls[0].note and the rendered table. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-settings-global-exclusions.

claims.claim: Low impact is the rating for a change the rationale says Insider Risk Management administrators and analysts notice.
claims.quote: impact: "low"; rationale: "Insider Risk Management administrators and analysts notice it". SCHEMA defines medium impact as "specific roles such as makers, analysts or one business unit".
claims.fix: Set impact to 'medium' and replace the rationale with 'Medium. Insider Risk Management administrators and analysts notice fewer low-signal Endpoint events in activity explorer and scoring. Other users see no change in the roadmap description.'
